calculationEntry.alt: The current gift-kit workflow 2.8.0 offers Explore example and Start with my data.
calculationEntry.caption: Explore example starts a fictional campaign. Start with my data creates a separate blank case using the same published workflow.

calculationBlank.alt: Starting with your own data leaves the gift-kit inputs unanswered and the Decision summary uncalculated.
calculationBlank.caption: A blank case does not inherit the fictional campaign’s observations, permissions or booking. Supply the complete case before treating a finding as applicable.

calculationInputs.alt: A supplied one-day gift-kit case shows 120 kits, a $600 expense boundary and Calculate beside a pending Decision summary.
calculationInputs.caption: Leah checks the supplied commitment in Forms. Calculate assesses the evidence and complete correction options in dependency order.

calculationSummary.alt: The concise Decision summary prefers the $300 internal complete correction, ready at minute 40, and compares the supported complete packages, with three other options available in a disclosure.
calculationSummary.caption: Options leads with the supported complete packages. Other options retains the partial fixes; Next actions, Assumptions and Questions have separate sections.

ampleSummary.alt: With a full day available, the same cost-first workflow prefers the $300 internal complete correction at minute 40.
ampleSummary.caption: Full day: the $300 complete correction fits and costs less than the confirmed external package.

calculationNextActions.alt: The gift-kit Decision summary Next actions section separates that question from the option comparison.
calculationNextActions.caption: Next actions has its own focused section; switching sections does not change the case or recalculate the findings.

calculationAssumptions.alt: The gift-kit Decision summary Assumptions section separates that question from the option comparison.
calculationAssumptions.caption: Assumptions has its own focused section; switching sections does not change the case or recalculate the findings.

calculationQuestions.alt: The gift-kit Decision summary Questions section separates that question from the option comparison.
calculationQuestions.caption: Questions has its own focused section; switching sections does not change the case or recalculate the findings.

calculationQuestionOutline.alt: The gift-kit decision question breaks into Options, Next actions, Assumptions and Questions, with separate supporting evidence and planning questions.
calculationQuestionOutline.caption: The question breakdown explains how the summary and supporting assessments contribute to the gift-kit decision.

calculationEvidence.alt: The Rehearsal basis supporting report shows the scoped checks and the records used or excluded from the gift-kit evidence assessment.
calculationEvidence.caption: Evidence establishes what the complete correction must address. A successful old checkout does not verify the corrected kits.

calculationPlanning.alt: The Correction choice supporting report inspects the complete in-house correction and explains its calculated fit, timing and expense.
calculationPlanning.caption: Select the complete in-house correction to inspect its calculated fit. This inspection changes neither the recommendation nor the recorded case.

calculationProcess.alt: The gift-kit Decision process connects evidence, complete arrangements and remaining business actions, with the current case overlaid on its branches.
calculationProcess.caption: The authored process explains what to do when records conflict, work does not fit or a supported correction is available. It describes possible responses, not completed work.

calculationProcessDetail.alt: A selected gift-kit decision point shows its current finding, recorded basis and the paths that follow from it.
calculationProcessDetail.caption: Inspect the decision point to connect the calculated finding with its assumptions and available next questions. Inspection records no correction work or authorization.

calculationDependencies.alt: Calculation dependencies shows the evidence result feeding the gift-kit planning assessment and the resulting summary.
calculationDependencies.caption: This map explains how the supporting assessments connect. Opening it does not calculate or accept a result.

urgentSummary.alt: With thirty minutes remaining, the same cost-first workflow supports the confirmed $400 external correction, finishing at minute 1435.
urgentSummary.caption: Thirty minutes left: internal work finishes too late; the confirmed external package preserves five minutes before the same cutoff.

oldBookingSummary.alt: With the same urgent inputs but a booking for insert-2 instead of current insert-3, the Decision summary shows no supported complete correction.
oldBookingSummary.caption: A quote for fast work cannot replace a current booking. The old insert revision blocks external work while internal work still misses the deadline.

calculationPending.alt: The uncommitted $200 budget edit is flagged while the report continues to describe the last recorded $600 case.
calculationPending.caption: Draft input is separate from the recorded basis. Apply or discard the edit before recalculating.

calculationStale.alt: After the $200 limit is applied, the alternatives are marked stale and the earlier current correction proposal is withdrawn.
calculationStale.caption: Changed spending invalidates the planning basis. Recalculate reassesses the affected result; unchanged evidence remains current and the earlier planning finding remains historical.

calculationBlocked.alt: Under the $200 spending boundary, the completed calculation finds no supplied complete correction that meets the requirements.
calculationBlocked.caption: The $100 and $180 partial corrections leave faults unresolved; the $300 and $400 complete packages exceed the new limit.

calculationMobile.alt: The current gift-kit Decision summary retains the finding, complete comparison and supporting navigation on a phone.
calculationMobile.caption: The compact summary grows with the page; complete reports remain available when needed.

What assumptions and limits do these results depend on?

These results apply within the following scope and assumptions.

Calculation scope

One gift-kit batch under the recorded insert, destination and checkout revisions. Compare only the authored complete preparation packages across every remaining permitted explanation; a prospective fit does not establish completed correction, rehearsal or handoff. Recipient experience and campaign effectiveness are outside this calculation.

Material assumptions
Current reports are treated as accurate only for their recorded batch, revisions, device and account scope. All declared fault combinations remain possible until excluded by those reports.
Correction effects are authored planning assumptions. One complete static preparation package must work across every admitted fault combination; the calculation does not construct an adaptive sequence of checks.
Each complete-package quotation must match the stated kit quantity and include its own duration and expense. Quantity does not automatically scale either amount.
The recorded person, production resource, access and permission intervals apply throughout correction, scoped rehearsal and handoff. Available budget or a passing calculation does not supply missing permission.
